views.text: In September 2026, Equity Mates explained Washington H. Soul Pattinson evolved from a 1903-listed pharmacy chain to a permanent-capital investment house that invests its own balance sheet, enabling an endowment-style, long-term approach to its product of managing investments.

views.text: In March 2021, a guest on Equity Mates described its shift beyond pharmacies into a diversified investment business spanning mining, resources, telecommunications and more, built after a cross-shareholding with Brickworks and subsequent sector expansions.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In September 2026, Equity Mates said permanent capital with no unit holders expecting redemptions allowed truly long-term, unconstrained investing, which was presented as a structural edge that could support sustained above-market profitability.
